functions.name: famfs_kill_sb
functions.summary: Frees fsi and NULLs s_fs_info BEFORE calling kill_char_super — secondary bug

functions.name: famfs_mknod
functions.summary: Uses d_instantiate+dget without DCACHE_PERSISTENT — primary bug

functions.name: select_collect_umount
functions.summary: Only drops dentry pin for DCACHE_PERSISTENT dentries; bare dget pins are invisible to it

functions.name: d_make_persistent
functions.summary: Correct replacement: instantiates dentry, sets DCACHE_PERSISTENT, bumps refcount atomically

functions.name: famfs_dax_notify_failure
functions.summary: Holds no dentry references; T1 eliminated

theories.title: famfs_kill_sb holds dax reference that pins dentries
theories.description: DAX device reference released before kill_char_super, not after. DAX holder ops hold no dentry references.
evidence_against: fs_put_dax() is called BEFORE kill_char_super() in famfs_kill_sb
theories.elimination_reason: DAX ordering is correct; DAX path holds no dentry references

theories.title: famfs_mknod bare dget() without DCACHE_PERSISTENT leaks dentry refcount at unmount
theories.description: famfs_mknod calls d_instantiate()+dget() to pin dentries. select_collect_umount() only drops pins for dentries with DCACHE_PERSISTENT set. Since bare dget() never sets DCACHE_PERSISTENT, every famfs file dentry has refcount=1 at umount_check time.
evidence_for: select_collect_umount (dcache.c:1550): only decrements count if DCACHE_PERSISTENT set
d_make_persistent (dcache.c:2796): the correct API — sets DCACHE_PERSISTENT + dget atomically
Every famfs file dentry shows refcount=1 at unmount — matches per-file pin pattern

theories.title: famfs metadata inode/dentry not released before shrink_dcache
theories.description: famfs_fs_info contains no dentry, file, or inode pointer fields.
evidence_against: famfs_fs_info fields: mount_opts, dax_devp, rootdev (char*), daxdevno, deverror — no dentry/inode pointers
theories.elimination_reason: famfs_fs_info holds no dentry or inode references

confirmed_bug.summary: famfs_mknod uses bare dget() to pin dentries without setting DCACHE_PERSISTENT; select_collect_umount cannot release the pin at unmount
